parameters.name: BandwidthLimit
parameters.description: The inter-region bandwidth between the two regions. Unit: Mbps.

parameters.name: BandwidthType
parameters.description:
The method used to allocate bandwidth. Valid value:

- **BandwidthPackage** (default): allocates bandwidth from a bandwidth plan.

parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: LocalRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the local region.

Call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query the regions where network instances can be attached to a CEN instance.

parameters.name: OppositeRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the peer region.
